{{Quote|Ka'Pa, how nice of your men to recover my ship and load all the supplies for me.|Mara Jade, to Ka'Pa the Hutt|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The '''''Shrike''''' was [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade's]] stealthy [[Alpha-52 starfighter|Alpha-52]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], a long-term loan from [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]]. Jade flew it on missions for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Smugglers' Alliance]].

==History==
===First flights===
The ''Shrike'' was [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]]'s modified [[Alpha-52 starfighter]], never developed for the open market, and he permanently loaned it to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]],<ref name="CSWE" /> his old friend.<ref name="MOTS" /> In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' occured five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' took place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Jade brought the ''Shrike'' to the [[Altyr V base|New Republic base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]] where she [[Reciprocal apprenticeship|trained]] with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]].<ref name="MOTS" />

===New Republic missions===
{{Quote|This looks like a good place to land.|Mara Jade in the ''Shrike''|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
Under her [[Unidentified New Republic commander|commander's]] [[Mission to negotiate supplies from Ka'Pa the Hutt|orders]], Jade [[Hyperspace/Legends|flew]] her [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] ship to [[Ka'Pa's palace]] to negotiate with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for supplies, then followed [[Ka'Pa]]'s directions to the planet [[Katraasii]] for a [[Global Communications Transponder|device]] stolen by his rival, [[Takara]]. Jade docked the ''Shrike'' and searched the [[Katraasii Spaceport|spaceport]], but Takara's [[Takara's organization|agents]] captured Jade and brought her to [[Takara's stronghold]]. Ka'Pa's agents retrieved the ''Shrike'', and once Jade escaped with the surveillance device, Ka'Pa returned her [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] along with supplies [[Freighter/Legends|loaded]] onboard.<ref name="MOTS" />

===Personal obligations===
[[File:Maramon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jade contacts Mon Mothma.]]
{{Quote|Do what you must, but keep in touch.''"<br />"''I'll contact you as soon as I know anything. Jade out.|Mon Mothma and Mara Jade over the ship's comm|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
Following Jade's [[Seizure of the Jedi holocron|retrieval]] of a [[Jedi holocron/Legends|Jedi holocron]], she [[Sublight engine/Legends|left]] [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] space aboard the ''Shrike'' when she [[Comm unit/Legends|contacted]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] about Katarn's prolonged absence. [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|Searching]] for Katarn on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], she [[Repulsorlift/Legends|landed]] her ship in a swamp clearing. Jade rescued Katarn from the [[Dark Force Temple]], and they [[Transport/Legends|left]] the planet together.<ref name="MOTS" /> In the following [[Time/Legends|years]], Jade preferred the nimble ''Shrike'' for stealth missions under Karrde's [[Smugglers' Alliance]].<ref name="Essential" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Shrike_3D_model.png|thumb|right|140px|3D models of the ''Shrike'']]
The ''Shrike'' first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> As they developed the visual design of the ship, [[Kevin Schmitt]] and other members of the design team sent a 3D model to [[LucasArts]]{{'}} Licensing department for approval as Jade's new ship. While the art featured the ''Shrike'' firing weapons,<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|schmittmypants|status/1299129393676050433|[[Kevin Schmitt]]|archivedate=20200827233946}}</ref> the ship did not engage in combat during the game.<ref name="MOTS" />
